5 minutes (if you already have the gold)

The {wiki:Golden Outfits|Golden Outfit} is not earned by fighting: it is bought with a gigantic donation to one of the monarchs — {npc:King Tibianus} (Thais), {npc:Queen Eloise} (Carlin) or {npc:Emperor Kruzak} (Kazordoon). The armour costs 500,000,000 gp and each addon (boots and helmet) another 250,000,000 gp. Besides the outfit you receive the matching {item:The Golden Outfit Display (Basic)|The Golden Outfit Display} and your name is engraved on the {wiki:Memorial|Memorials}.

Shining brightly against the darkness, the legendary golden outfit lights the way to glory and greatness. Radiating a unique magnificence and extravagance, those of royal blood only grant it to the most prestigious and prosperous Tibians, in exchange for a generous donation.
King Tibianus, Thais castle (or Queen Eloise / Emperor Kruzak)
1,000,000,000 gp in total for the full outfit.
250,000,000 gp for the boots and gloves addon
{wiki:Golden Outfits|Golden Outfit} (armor) and both addons (boots/gloves and helmet)
Your character's name is listed in the {wiki:Memorial|Memorials}
Choose only **one** of the three monarchs: they all sell the same outfit.
Greet them correctly: {key:hail king} (Tibianus), {key:hail queen} (Eloise) or {key:hail emperor} (Kruzak).
Go to one of these three monarchs (it makes no difference which):
Greet the monarch ({key:hail king}, {key:hail queen} or {key:hail emperor}). Say {key:outfit} (or {key:addon}) and {key:yes}. Then say {key:armor} and confirm with {key:yes}.
Greet the monarch, say {key:addon} (or {key:outfit}) and {key:yes}. Then say {key:boots} and confirm with {key:yes}.
Boots and gloves addon + The Golden Outfit Display (Boots)
Greet the monarch, say {key:addon} (or {key:outfit}) and {key:yes}. Then say {key:helmet} and confirm with {key:yes}.
Helmet addon + The Golden Outfit Display (Helmet)
With the armour and both addons you have the complete Golden Outfit and the {item:The Golden Outfit Display (Complete)}.
The dialogues above are with Queen Eloise; with King Tibianus and Emperor Kruzak the keywords are the same, only the greeting changes.
There are no creatures or dangers in this quest: the only obstacle is gathering the gold.
